nodes.guardrail: Before deepening economy and tech, verify no early enemy pressure or hidden tech. If enemy units or production structures are spotted, prioritize defense and scouting over expansion.
nodes.recheck_condition: Re-evaluate when enemy army composition or production structures are observed, or upon reaching a new tech milestone.
